title: 安排工作以达到最大收益
summary: 每个工人至多完成一份难度不超过其能力的工作，同类工作可重复安排，求总最大收益。
insight: 按难度排序工作、按能力排序工人；扫描工人时持续纳入可完成工作并维护历史最高利润，每人取该最高值。
pitfalls: 工作可被多个工人重复选择
利润不保证随难度递增，要维护前缀最大
能力不足任何工作时贡献零

solutions.title: 排序工人与工作双指针
solutions.idea: 一次扫描维护当前能力可达的最高利润。
steps: 把 difficulty/profit 配对并按难度排序，worker 排序
对每个 ability，推进 job 指针纳入 difficulty<=ability 的工作，更新 bestProfit

code.java: class Solution { public int maxProfitAssignment(int[] difficulty,int[] profit,int[] worker){int n=difficulty.length;int[][] jobs=new int[n][2];for(int i=0;i<n;i++){jobs[i][0]=difficulty[i];jobs[i][1]=profit[i];}Arrays.sort(jobs,Comparator.comparingInt(a->a[0]));Arrays.sort(worker);int answer=0,best=0,index=0;for(int ability:worker){while(index<n&&jobs[index][0]<=ability){best=Math.max(best,jobs[index][1]);index++;}answer+=best;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxProfitAssignment(difficulty:IntArray,profit:IntArray,worker:IntArray):Int{val jobs=difficulty.indices.map{intArrayOf(difficulty[it],profit[it])}.sortedBy{it[0]};worker.sort();var answer=0;var best=0;var index=0;for(ability in worker){while(index<jobs.size&&jobs[index][0]<=ability){best=maxOf(best,jobs[index][1]);index++};answer+=best};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maxProfitAssignment(vector<int>& difficulty,vector<int>& profit,vector<int>& worker){vector<pair<int,int>> jobs;for(int i=0;i<(int)difficulty.size();++i)jobs.push_back({difficulty[i],profit[i]});sort(jobs.begin(),jobs.end());sort(worker.begin(),worker.end());int answer=0,best=0,index=0;for(int ability:worker){while(index<(int)jobs.size()&&jobs[index].first<=ability){best=max(best,jobs[index].second);++index;}answer+=best;}return answer;} };
